_doc: NOAA CPC forecast products read by research/noaa_forecast_vintage.py. A new product is a ROW here, never code: give it an id, one of the parser formats the module knows (cpc_dd7_pipe, cpc_dd_monthly_fixed), its URL (a {yyyy}/{mm}/{dd} template for a dated archive, a fixed URL for a product that is overwritten in place), its cadence and the MT5 instruments it informs. Instruments are checked against desks/mt5/data/universe/universe.json every pass; one the registry lacks is reported and dropped, never traded.
user_agent: quant-desk-research/1.0 (NOAA CPC public-domain forecast vintages; one request at a time, robots.txt obeyed)
terms_basis: US Government work (17 U.S.C. 105). NWS disclaimer: https://www.weather.gov/disclaimer.php

products.why: Residential/commercial gas burn is heating load weighted by gas-heated homes: the revision of the next week's gas-weighted HDD is the weather term in storage expectations.
Electric heating load is met partly by gas-fired generation: power-sector gas burn in winter.
The population-weighted HDD the market quotes as 'the weather'.
Summer air-conditioning load is met at the margin by gas-fired power: CDD revisions are the power-burn term.
CPC's long-lead monthly degree-day outlook (issued with the monthly/seasonal outlooks): the revision of the winter strip's expected HDD between issues.
